source_refs.anchor: Orthogonal lifecycle gates; AUTHORIAL_TRUTH_LOCKED, SCENE_READY, NARRATOR_PERMISSION.
D10 role adapters and emergency route to Dramaturgo.
D10 V002 evidence, request-bound approvals, finding-linked remediation records, readback and runtime support manifest.

preconditions: The current D10 adapter always returns HOLD for NARRATOR while D01/D10 remain PROPOSED_NON_OPERATIONAL.
A future adapter must prove semantic_validation_passed_for_exact_payload against verified sources; a caller flag alone is insufficient.
A future separately approved operational adapter must validate the exact payload and source blobs before projection.
SCENE_READY and NARRATOR_PERMISSION must be independently verified for the same exact scene and event.
Player consent, documentary release, all required gates, operational commit and readback must be verified from authoritative evidence; caller-supplied booleans are never authority.
deny: all narration while this proposal-only adapter is in force

DRAMATURGO.on_emergency: HOLD_AND_REVIEW; no narration, mutation or secret projection

global_rules: D01 schema_status PROPOSED_NON_OPERATIONAL cannot satisfy narrator operational preconditions.
NARRATOR_PERMISSION and SCENE_READY are independent, exact-scene checks.
A private repository is not effective GM-hidden segregation; this D10 proposal rejects every GM_HIDDEN payload because no independently verified segregation attestation mechanism exists.
An empty placeholder is not AUTHORIAL_TRUTH_LOCKED.
An emergency routes to Dramaturgo and leaves the scene on HOLD.
Role adaptation is projection only; it cannot create facts, knowledge, reciprocal relationship edges, causal links or events.
Each projection validates the exact bundle and requires source paths and blob SHAs to match the Git tree at a caller-independent expected source HEAD.
NPC knowledge requires a source-backed acquisition record bound to the knower, an in-checkpoint event, method, verified evidence and event ordering; free-form acquisition ID lists have no authority.
Applied retcons require a structured player decision record backed by verified source/evidence, with exact RETCON_APPROVAL scope and exact affected references.
Caller-supplied booleans cannot establish segregation, narrator permission, scene readiness, consent, release approval or readback.
Successful phase transitions and D12 final release require every validation check to pass, completed reviews, authorized branch publication, and verified readback.
Caller-supplied event IDs are never authoritative; IDs are derived from the numerically latest cycle on the independently verified master ref.
Claim-bearing source refs require an exact JSON pointer into a blob referenced by that cycle and exact field equality for each asserted claim.
D12 gate values are resolved from pinned current handoffs; every approval queue is read from the same Git tree and unresolved entries block final release.
Publication success requires Git fetch, actual remote ref, commit parent, tree, added paths, blob IDs and bytes; booleans and SHA-shaped strings alone have no evidentiary value.

Every authoritative cycle, semantic source, phase handoff, approval queue, review/test report, remediation evidence ref and published artifact must be a regular Git blob pinned to its verified tree; symlinks and non-blob entries fail closed.
Each KNOWN knowledge fact_ref must equal the fact_ref of the exact source-backed acquisition referenced by acquisition_ref; an acquisition of one fact cannot support another.

Approval queues are grouped by stable decision ID and fingerprinted over every player-facing request field except stable ID, status and resolution metadata. Divergent or unverifiable copies remain pending; a terminal status can resolve copies only when all request fingerprints match, the queue and exact latest-cycle PLAYER_DECISION bind that SHA256, and decision ID, status, scope, affected refs, event and evidence match.

Review finding IDs must be unique and non-empty within each report. A review cannot pass with OPEN findings; material findings require a structured remediation record bound to that exact finding ID and typed refs to regular deliverable blobs whose SHA and anchor resolve at the pinned review HEAD; symlinks and other non-blob entries fail closed. The validator proves linkage and source integrity; independent review checks substantive relevance. Exact self-paths and byte-identical copies fail closed; modified copies cannot be detected from hashes alone and require independent semantic scrutiny; bounded unknowns require PASS_WITH_UNKNOWN.
D10 V002 runtime includes tracked support artifact D10_VALIDATE_V001.py; its V001 label is dependency provenance only and does not confer an earlier phase gate.
D10 V002 runtime includes tracked support artifact D10_SCHEMA_REGISTRY_V001.json; its V001 label is dependency provenance only and does not confer an earlier phase gate.

validation_behavior.checkpoint: The validator selects the numerically highest CYCLE_V*.json from origin/master, checks its blob and derives the only supported event cursor from checkpoint.last_event_id. The caller bundle must match that exact cycle; unsupported earlier event IDs remain UNKNOWN.
validation_behavior.semantic_sources: Acquisition, PLAYER decision, CANON_EVENT and CAUSAL_LINK claims require exact JSON pointer evidence within the latest cycle refs and exact asserted-field equality. Generic tracked files and source verification labels cannot prove claims.
validation_behavior.publication: The validator fetches origin refs and checks current documentary branch ancestry, actual commit parent and tree, new-file-only deliverable diff, and every manifest blob/content. It does not trust booleans.
validation_behavior.prior_gates: Each D01-D11 status derives from its exact version-pinned authoritative handoff at verified HEAD. Repeated approval entries are fingerprinted over every request field other than stable ID, status and resolution metadata; divergent copies remain pending. A terminal resolution requires the queue, every repeated request copy and the exact latest-cycle PLAYER_DECISION to bind the same SHA256 request fingerprint and matching decision ID, status, scope, affected refs, event and evidence.
validation_behavior.reviews: Technical and literary review status requires a tracked report with matching phase/role, reviewer identity distinct from author, result and structured findings with unique stable IDs. A passing result is rejected for OPEN findings; MATERIAL/BLOCKER/CRITICAL require RESOLVED plus a record bound to the exact finding ID, a remediation summary and typed source refs to regular Git blobs pinned to the review HEAD with resolving JSON-pointer or text anchors. The validator checks source integrity and linkage; independent reviewers judge substantive relevance and detect modified copies. BOUNDED_UNKNOWN requires PASS_WITH_UNKNOWN.
validation_behavior.narrator: Always HOLD while the D01/D10 contracts remain PROPOSED_NON_OPERATIONAL; no D10 artifact grants operational permission.
